subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support remote `http(s)` avatars, or should remote avatar inputs remain unsupported for Control UI rendering and be rejected or diagnosed clearly?
rationale: The choice changes CSP, operator-browser network privacy, avatar route behavior, and the public avatar configuration contract, so automation should not silently pick the policy.

options.title: Keep local/data-only rendering
options.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI/docs/validation/UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

options.title: Add a same-origin proxy/cache
options.body: Support remote avatars only through a gateway-owned fetch/proxy/cache with strict MIME, size, auth, caching, privacy, and failure-feedback behavior.

options.title: Allow direct remote loads
options.body: Let the browser load configured remote avatar URLs directly and accept the CSP and operator-browser privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep local/data-only rendering
recommendation.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI/docs/validation/UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties this person to the original avatar support, CSP/control-ui contract work, and current central-file ownership.
